description: This Java class defines the MongoDB indices used by the 'thingsearch' persistence module in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies different index configurations for filtering, global reads, policies, namespace, and deletion timestamps, providing a centralized configuration for database index management.

classes.name: Indices
classes.description: Defines the MongoDB indices used for the 'thingsearch' persistence; provides static methods and index configurations.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all configured MongoDB indices used by the persistence layer.
